जलविद्युत विकासका लागि नदी र भौगोलिक ढलानको कुनै महत्व हुँदैन
पर्यटन स्थलको अवस्थिति आर्थिक गतिविधिसँग असम्बन्धित हुन्छ
questions.explanation: नेपालको भौगोलिक विविधता कृषि, पर्यटन र जलविद्युतलगायत आर्थिक गतिविधिका अवसरसँग जोडिएको छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल

options: Both I and II are implicit
questions.solution: The recommendation presumes both a communication difficulty and that clearer guidance can address it.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statement: A road was closed for maintenance for seven days, during which traffic was diverted to an alternative route. Conclusions: I. The original road required maintenance. II. The alternative route was shorter.
questions.solution: The closure for maintenance directly supports I. No comparison of route lengths is given.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A person may enter a restricted room only if they have an access card and are on the approved list. Maya has an access card but is not on the approved list. What follows?
options: Maya must be on the approved list
The rule does not apply to Maya
questions.solution: Both conditions are required; lacking the approved-list condition means Maya may not enter.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: An agency's emergency procurement records show repeated missing justifications. Which course is most appropriate first?
options: Review the cases, identify the control failure, and require documented justification
Ignore the issue because emergencies are unpredictable
questions.solution: A targeted review can identify the weakness and lead to corrective controls without abandoning necessary emergency procurement.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five tasks A, B, C, D and E must be scheduled Monday to Friday, one per day. B must be after A. C must be immediately before D. E must be Friday. Which task must be Wednesday?
questions.solution: Since C-D must be consecutive and E is Friday, the pair must be Monday-Tuesday or Wednesday-Thursday. If Monday-Tuesday, A and B must occupy Wednesday-Thursday, so Wednesday could be A. Thus no listed task must be Wednesday.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six books P, Q, R, S, T and U are arranged left to right. P is left of Q. R is immediately right of S. T is between Q and U. Which arrangement is possible?
options: Q P T U S R
P T Q U S R
P Q U T S R
P Q T U S R
questions.solution: P-Q-T-U-S-R satisfies P before Q, R immediately after S, and T between Q and U.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “permanent”.

questions.solution: “waive” means to give up or refrain from enforcing a requirement; “wave” refers to a gesture or moving swell.

questions.question: In “The data are inconclusive,” what does “inconclusive” mean?
options: not sufficient to prove a definite result
questions.solution: The context indicates that “not sufficient to prove a definite result” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to “scarce”.
A medicine or treatment used to prevent disease is
Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ available today.
questions.solution: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject; assistants is plural, so are is correct.

questions.question: The decision was made ___ accordance with the law.
questions.solution: The fixed expression is in accordance with.

questions.question: When the director arrived, the staff ___ for two hours.
questions.solution: An action continuing before another past event takes past perfect continuous.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'No other applicant was as qualified as Maya.'
options: Maya was the most qualified applicant.
Maya was less qualified than every applicant.
Every applicant was more qualified than Maya.
questions.solution: The superlative expresses the same comparison.

questions.question: Ten kilometres ___ a long distance to walk in the heat.
questions.solution: A distance treated as one unit takes a singular verb.

questions.question: The chairperson called ___ the meeting because several members were absent.
She ___ in Kathmandu since 2022.
questions.solution: Since a point in the past with continuing relevance normally takes the present perfect.

questions.question: ___ the evidence was limited, the committee reached a cautious conclusion.
